value.rationale: Natural complete graph classification over all finite commutative chain rings; an explicit 512-element counterexample to Arvind--Cameron class-two isoclinism conjecture, with nonisomorphic central quotients and derived subgroups. Gives a universal model, exact degree distribution and all-arity clique/commuting-tuple counts. Not a routine finite case or known two-generator corollary.
